construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.schema: Nonempty list of {entity, name, required}; allowlisted field names and boolean required
input.documents: Nonempty list of {id, entity, format, content}; content is always original source text

output.records: Each contains document_id, entity, fields, missing_fields
output.fields: Requested, present field names map to {value, source:{document_id,start,end}}
output.errors: One JSON object with status error and sanitized message; exit 2

shared_schema.source_offsets: Zero-based end-exclusive Unicode character offsets in document content. JSON includes value literal quotes; XML includes escaped text; text includes original value whitespace.
shared_schema.types: Identifier, text, ISO calendar date, finite nonnegative bounded amount, and allowlisted underwriting factor list
shared_schema.validation_layer: All source allowlisted fields are normalized and validated, including safety-relevant fields omitted from the requested output schema

cross_stage_handoffs: Single structured extraction functionality: request validation -> format parsing with exact spans -> shared value/industry validation -> minimized records and missing-field reporting
behavior: Deterministic extraction without external providers, LLMs, or injected callables
Nested object-based ACORD-style JSON; unqualified attribute-free ACORD-style XML; snake_case label: value claim-form text
Ambiguous fields and duplicate JSON keys fail rather than silently choosing values
Required missing fields produce incomplete status and exit 0; optional missing fields are reported without marking incomplete
No automatic claim adjudication. Extracted decisions require an exact compatible policy/evidence-based stated reason from the built-in demonstrative mapping
Underwriting permits roof_age, building_material, annual_mileage and prior_claim_count only; used factors must be disclosed
Output minimization omits names, raw addresses, VINs, raw source documents and all unrequested fields
Clearly labeled synthetic example with invented policyholder, fabricated VIN/address; seed-127 randomized loss dates and amounts exercised by tests

included: All three insurance entities and document formats

test_outcomes.suite: 18 unittest cases including seeded randomized fixtures and subprocess CLI behavior
